title: SeoMetadataRecord
description: Programmatic SEO metadata for ONE indexable detail page. Covers both libraries (211 A/B test pages + 255 canonical journey pages = 466 active pages). A frontend renders a page's metadata by reading only seoTitle, seoDescription, canonicalPath, index, follow and sitemap — nothing else in this record is required at render time; the remaining fields exist for auditing and regeneration. Merged/redirect records are NOT represented here: they keep the separate journey-merged-id-contract.json and must never be given detail-page metadata.

id.description: AB-### for an A/B test page, XXX-## for a canonical journey page.

seoTitle.description: 50-60 characters preferred. Must not contain the record's own ID, an unproven superlative (best/ultimate/proven/guaranteed/top/#1), or a performance claim. Uniqueness is enforced across the whole 466-page corpus by validate-seo-metadata.mjs, not by this schema.

seoDescription.description: 140-155 characters preferred, 120-165 tolerated. Explains what the page shows. Must not be an ad slogan, a restatement of the title, or a near-copy of another record's description.

primaryIntent.description: The broad library-level search intent. The first four belong to the A/B test library, the last four to the journey library — a record must not use the other library's set.

secondaryIntent.description: Page-specific intent, derived from the record's real subject/surface. Free-form because the subject space is the library's own, not a fixed keyword list.

canonicalPath.description: Path only, no origin. The deployment layer binds SITE_URL and the /tr counterpart via src/lib/seo.ts's pageAlternates — this file deliberately does not hardcode a domain.

sourceBasis.description: Which canonical source fields this metadata was actually derived from. Provenance, not decoration — a record with no sourceBasis is a record nobody can audit.

needsSeoReview.description: True where a human still has to decide something: a title that had to exceed 60 characters, or a genuine subject collision with a neighbouring record. Deliberately NOT driven to zero — hiding a real collision behind artificially differentiated wording is worse than flagging it.

reviewReason.description: Required (non-null) whenever needsSeoReview is true; must be null otherwise.
